name: Katsurao (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Katsurao village emblem in white: a ring open at the fly with a stylised arrowhead.
history: Municipal flag of Katsurao, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 4 February 1977.

features.role: Katsurao village emblem — a ring open at the fly with a stylised arrowhead
